finalText:
Found it: the failure wasn't in lint (those are just warnings) — it was in the bundle stage. `packages/shared/config.js` merged config layers with `Object.assign`, which is shallow, so any package overriding one key inside `output` or `sourcemap` (e.g. `@acme/api` overriding just `output.format`) silently wiped out the sibling keys (`output.dir`, `output.entry`), leaving `resolveRelease` returning an incomplete config and aborting the build.

Fixed by replacing the shallow merge with a recursive `deepMerge` that merges nested plain objects key-by-key across all three layers (defaults → package overrides → CLI flags), while leaving `RELEASE_DEFAULTS` unmutated. `build.js` now exits 0, and `verify.js` (the stricter ground-truth check, including an override case not in the fixtures) also passes.
